observation: the full-cosine odd gap remains positive and changes by less than 3e-5 relative at every two-mode enlargement through eight active modes in the declared scan; the increments are not monotone, so no tail extrapolation is certified
scalingBoundary: eight active modes at cutoff six already require 3003 parity-split basis states; a dense full-cosine matrix makes the next simultaneous mode-and-cutoff rung the computational bottleneck

boundary: The eight-mode rung is not independently cutoff-converged to the same standard as the six-mode rung, and no monotone or rigorous truncation-error bound controls the omitted sixteen modes. These data do not establish the 24-mode gap or the thermodynamic coupled-wire bulk gap.
